final_text: Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `solution.py`. It tracks hits/misses with an LRU list, moves hit keys to most-recently-used, evicts the least-recently-used key on overflow (recording evictions in order), and returns `{cache, hits, misses, evictions}`. Non-positive capacity yields all misses with empty cache/evictions and zero hits. Inputs are not mutated.
